prompt: Which plan meets the room, staff and timing rules?
promptZh: 哪個方案符合教室、講師和時間規定？

options.text: 10:00: live turn in H with Jules; 10:20: review in H with Bea by video.
options.zh: 10:00：在 H 室和朱爾斯實機操作；10:20：在 H 室與貝雅視訊檢視。
options.whyZh: 時間及人員看似可行，但 H 室不得進行實機控制面板練習。

options.text: 10:00: live turn in E with Jules; 10:20: review in H with Bea by video.
options.zh: 10:00：在 E 室和朱爾斯實機操作；10:20：在 H 室與貝雅視訊檢視。
options.whyZh: 艾拉及朱爾斯皆在現場有十分鐘可排；實機用 E，貝雅在可上線時進行不送指令的 H 室檢視。

options.text: 10:00: live turn in E with Dev as the only instructor; 10:20: review in H with Bea by video.
options.zh: 10:00：在 E 室由戴夫獨自指導實機操作；10:20：在 H 室與貝雅視訊檢視。
options.whyZh: 戴夫遠端可觀摩，但不能算 E 室的講師。

options.text: 10:00: review in H with Bea; 10:20: live turn in E with Jules.
options.zh: 10:00：在 H 室與貝雅檢視；10:20：在 E 室與朱爾斯實機操作。
options.whyZh: 順序反了，貝雅 10:00 尚無法視訊，且朱爾斯 10:20 已到現場可用時間的末點。

explanationZh: 艾拉及朱爾斯皆在現場有十分鐘可排；實機用 E，貝雅在可上線時進行不送指令的 H 室檢視。
evidence: A group that takes turns at a live control panel must use Room E with its instructor station. / A participant who has already completed the control-panel check may attend an explanation by video. / Room H is for discussion and paper exercises only. / Ira | outstanding | on site 10:00–11:00 / Jules | qualified instructor | on site 10:00–10:20 / Bea | complete | video only after 10:15 / The live turn must finish before the review begins. / The review will show a recording of the panel on screen. It will not let anyone send a command.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A group that takes turns at a live control panel must use Room E with its instructor station.
A participant who has already completed the control-panel check may attend an explanation by video.
Room H is for discussion and paper exercises only.
The live turn must finish before the review begins.
The review will show a recording of the panel on screen. It will not let anyone send a command.

vocabulary.note: 每人有一段自己的操作時間。
